situational_context: Running comeback at 153 days (≥37 runs since May 3, 2026). Gravel reintroduced with 2 significant rides (22.5 km Sep 15, 49.6 km Sep 21 — the latter drove a transient ACWR spike to ~2.45, now resolved at 0.55). Running consolidated at 5 km easy (3 consecutive runs at 4-5 km since Sep 17, all HR ≤ 140, suffer ≤ 26). C4 block (#21-40) expired Sep 13 without achieving 12 km Beaumonts objective — archived today; block ran roughly half its prescribed sessions. Gravel is now a meaningful training modality alongside running and e-bike commuting. MEDICATION (standing, from protocols/health-profile.md): Benjamin is on Wegovy (semaglutide, GLP-1 receptor agonist) — escalated from 0.25 mg to 0.5 mg on Wednesday 2026-09-30 (confirmed via calendar injection event; decision at the Sep 15 consultation with Dr Monnier). Day 52 of therapy, day 3 at 0.5 mg. Dose escalation watch active until Oct 14. Last injection Wed Sep 30; next Wed Oct 7. Post-injection side-effect window Thu–Sat (today Oct 3 = last day of window). HRV 7d avg stable at 30 (LOW/UNBALANCED since mid-Aug), expected class effect. Body battery persistently low (33–51). Weight flat at ~100.8 kg (only 2 Withings readings since Sep 5). Muscle mass UP (69.54→71.14 kg between readings) — reassuring for lean-mass preservation. 41 consecutive days without nutrition logging (since Aug 23) — on GLP-1 at 0.5 mg with intensifying appetite suppression, protein floor and energy availability are unverifiable. VO2max running improved to 42.8 (from 42.2). VO2max cycling corrected to 37.7 (42.9 artifact resolved). Dr Bouriot (Ipso Nation) appointment Oct 8. No new labs since Dec 2025; Vitamin D retest 4+ months overdue.
